name: Indigo iUSD
oneLiner: iUSD is Indigo Protocol's decentralized synthetic dollar on Cardano, minted against overcollateralized CDP vaults of Cardano-native assets.
collateral: Overcollateralized Indigo Protocol CDP vaults using ADA or DAO-whitelisted Cardano native tokens, plus stablecoins deposited through governed iUSD peg-stability modules
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized multi-collateral CDP synthetic dollar with per-iAsset Stability Pools, collateral redemptions, DAO-set interest and collateral parameters, and governed peg-stability modules that can mint or redeem iUSD against approved stablecoins

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 reserve batch 7; re-verified by Kimi T21 unknown-reduction wave 2
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Indigo V3 documents iAssets as overcollateralized Cardano CDPs that may use ADA or DAO-whitelisted Cardano native tokens, with additional governed peg-stability modules for approved stablecoin pairs. The Koios policy record anchors the Cardano implementation boundary used for the implementation date. Re-verified 2026-07-30: the live V3 documentation still describes iUSD as single-collateral-type overcollateralized loans with per-pair liquidation, maintenance, and redemption ratios and Stability Pool liquidations, and Koios reports 1,480,346.261574 iUSD outstanding under the immutable PlutusV2 policy f66d78b4a3cb3d37afa0ec36461e51ecbde00f26c8f0a68f94b69880, so the cdp archetype stands.

oracleRisk.summary: Indigo V3 uses separate pull-based Pyth Lazer inverse-price feeds for the live ADA- and NIGHT-backed iUSD CDP branches. Signed prices are pushed through configured Cardano Pyth validators; no alternate oracle provider or fallback behavior is documented.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 recovery review
branchApplicability.rationale: Indigo V3 assigns each iAsset/collateral pair its own oracle and collateral parameters. The live Indigo analytics indexer reports 189 ADA-backed and six NIGHT-backed iUSD CDPs, and the official mainnet configuration identifies distinct Pyth inverse feeds and validator references for both pairs.

branches.label: ADA-backed iUSD CDPs
branches.summary: The live ADA/iUSD branch uses Pyth Lazer inverse feed 16 through Indigo's configured Cardano Pyth validator; the indexer reported 189 positions at the review snapshot.

feeds.path: Signed Pyth message -> inverse feed 16 (iUSD per ADA pair) -> Cardano Pyth feed validator 4cb907af98c1ed5ee9f251691a0ec909f2a26b583ed271f2a88a55cb -> Indigo CDP validation

branches.fallbackBehavior: The reviewed configuration and MCP implementation identify Pyth Lazer as the branch provider but do not document an alternate provider, cached-price fallback, or the exact onchain behavior when an update is missing or expired.

collateralParameters.note: Indigo V3 requires pair-specific liquidation, maintenance, and redemption ratios. The public analytics snapshot identifies the active ADA branch but does not expose the current numeric ratios, which remain an explicit parameter-level unknown.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Indigo liquidations use a two-step freeze and liquidation flow. When an ADA-backed iUSD CDP breaches its branch ratio, the iUSD Stability Pool burns deposited iUSD against the debt and distributes seized ADA collateral to depositors.
branches.backstop: The iUSD Stability Pool is the documented liquidation backstop and is observable through Indigo's public stability-pool indexer. No separate recapitalization layer was established from the reviewed primary sources.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: The reviewed public documentation does not establish the exact stale-or-missing-price behavior, a global shutdown path, or a residual-debt cure if the iUSD Stability Pool cannot absorb a liquidation.

sources.label: Koios V3 PSM reference output API

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Indigo's V3 documentation, last updated 2026-06-25, describes an iUSD/USDCx Peg Stabilization Module: USDCx-to-iUSD minting and iUSD-to-USDCx redemption. It states that the DAO can enable or disable each direction of a stable pair and that the Indigo Foundation controlled loan redemptions at V3 launch. The official V3 configuration identifies PSM reference output 5a3581c7623683ca7a458f368d215816390c9cdaa8b5748deb7904b571889005#0; a Koios POST to utxo_info on 2026-07-15 returned PlutusV3 script hash 245425bb49411414dca4af8f25097c5a27f923249c0779ffaa2bc5a3, whose serialized validation messages include 'Minting is not enabled' and 'Redeeming is not enabled'. The current iUSD policy reference 8fac023fd9556f66ffdac8cb71879fabd6995480f7ad976213d1e1ee85de75cd#0 is PlutusV2, so the earlier policy was not treated as current PSM source evidence. Cardano documents that ordinary native-token transfers do not execute a policy, and no holder-address blacklist or direct iUSD transfer freeze was established. USDCx terms state that Circle may delay or deny xReserve USDC release and bridge parties may pause the bridge. This establishes possible governed PSM and upstream redemption-route access exposure, not a claim that an issuer can freeze standalone iUSD balances. Re-verified 2026-07-30: the live V3 documentation still describes the iUSD/USDCx PSM with DAO per-direction enable/disable and Foundation-controlled loan redemptions at launch; the mainnet system parameters still name stableswapHash 245425bb49411414dca4af8f25097c5a27f923249c0779ffaa2bc5a3 with the same reference output; a Koios address_assets query on the derived stableswap payment credential (enterprise address addr1wyj9gfdmf9q3g9xu5jhc7fgf03dz07fryjwqw70l4g4utgcsp3cwd) shows a single UTXO holding 4,400 iUSD and no stablecoin; and the USDCx Portal Terms of Use PDF and Indigo disclaimer both still resolve (HTTP 200).

sources.label: Koios address_assets for Indigo stableswap and CDP validator payment credentials

reserveReview.rationale: In a coordinated 2026-07-30 live fetch, Indigo's public indexer reported 188 ADA-backed iUSD CDPs with 1,289,374.623387 iUSD debt and seven NIGHT-backed CDPs with 3,895.620486 iUSD debt. Koios reported 1,480,346.261574 iUSD outstanding, so indexed CDP debt reconciles 87.3627% of supply: 87.0995% ADA debt and 0.2632% NIGHT debt, rounded here to 87.10% and 0.26%. The endpoints do not expose a shared historical snapshot slot, so the remaining 187,076.017701 iUSD, or 12.6373%, is preserved as an explicit unknown rather than normalized away. Tx-level Koios inspection of the largest mints between 2026-07-22 and 2026-07-30 (61aa93ba78b7ad387d3baae46ed5f59b8716515b6fefc76c5ef4e1138fa856f4, 9f64719273ad6f756d6161309206c39adb6bf75047998fe1c01b12a45945f7bb, 6e2832110e65b956e7af743cf555ea7e6908f7135a4ded09a1cec65853b3a872) shows new CDP outputs holding USDCx collateral (policy 1f3aec8bfe7ea4fe14c5f121e2a92e301afe414147860d557cac7e34, asset 5553444378) alongside CDP NFTs while 85,681.35, 15,489.29 and 27,803.68 iUSD were minted, directly evidencing USDCx-collateral iUSD CDP issuance since about 2026-07-23 that the public indexer does not yet list. A 2026-07-30 Koios address_assets check shows the stableswap (PSM) validator payment credential (enterprise address addr1wyj9gfdmf9q3g9xu5jhc7fgf03dz07fryjwqw70l4g4utgcsp3cwd) holding a single UTXO of 4,400 iUSD and no stablecoin, while the CDP validator payment credential (enterprise address addr1w8lsky9l7g8yk695j9yjukaxeqzg5uz8vwc2gh8zn9w6p0sy523pp) holds 156,397.028232 USDCx, 30,524.851380 USDM, and 1.711213 USDA - roughly $186.9k of stablecoin collateral consistent in size with the residual and with the Limitless USDCx/USDM collateral markets the V3 docs describe, but the public CDP indexer does not attribute those balances per iAsset, so no constituent link is asserted.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Outstanding iUSD supply attributed by live indexed CDP debt, with Indigo validator stablecoin balances inspected via Koios address_assets
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 187,076.017701 iUSD difference between total policy supply and indexed CDP debt is dominated by USDCx/USDM-collateral CDP markets not yet covered by the public indexer (mint transactions prove USDCx-collateral CDPs minting iUSD since about 2026-07-23), with smaller possible contributions from a peg-stability module, accrued interest, or another path; no reviewed public endpoint splits that 12.6373% remainder per iAsset, though stablecoin balances of similar size sit at the Indigo CDP validator payment credential.

mintAuthority.summary: iUSD is minted on Cardano by opening overcollateralized CDPs in Indigo Protocol against approved Cardano-native collateral; INDY token holders govern collateral onboarding, parameters, and stability mechanisms.

controls.label: Indigo CDP minting validators
controls.capDescription: iUSD (an iAsset) is minted only against overcollateralized Indigo CDP vaults of approved Cardano collateral; supply expands and contracts with collateralized positions and liquidations, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: Koios script_info re-verified 2026-07-20: the iUSD minting policy f66d78b4a3cb3d37afa0ec36461e51ecbde00f26c8f0a68f94b69880 is a plutusV2 script (1189 bytes, creation tx 99329591f444f68ed4a33ed664c146fbf278cf9202067974cfa1a26d09a34107, deployed Nov 2022). Cardano minting policies are immutable: the policy hash is the asset identity and its mint rules (overcollateralized CDP validation) cannot be replaced or upgraded for the existing iUSD asset. Indigo docs describe iUSD minted only against overcollateralized CDPs with Stability Pool liquidations.

controls.label: Indigo INDY DAO governance
controls.capDescription: INDY stakers vote on collateral types, CDP risk parameters, and protocol stability mechanisms through Indigo on-chain governance.
controls.evidence: Indigo's official mainnet V3 system parameters (config.indigoprotocol.io) name the on-chain governance surface: GOV_NFT policy 2fccae8bc1c8553a2185b2e77ccdea22f2e1d6e87beb80ef4eaf8cce, poll manager validator 2c64c712d8ea012866a0e52119409992dcbee828b5e89f58b6c13c68, governance execute validator 0e764163b06d954f2dcfecf8d3b257e2bfe3d326d5670e54ca1974ce (this control's address), treasury validator 46ffe1d162ef5c1c4d4c0b92eb410e8148c59c547952ebac39622abd, UPGRADE token ca72f111cc130ac311259181e0720516c044cee30704706a0299c2a8, and VERSION_RECORD token d626ddf398b0bca6e112cf0b78c8124b989a6ca4e7c0dfe8c18c7c2e. Koios script_info on 2026-07-20 confirmed all six resolve to live on-chain scripts (plutusV2 token policies, plutusV3 validators). INDY stakers vote through the poll manager; execution flows through the gov-execute validator against the treasury. Governance controls parameters and validator versions via the upgrade-token mechanism but cannot replace the immutable iUSD minting policy.

review.evidence: 2026-07-20 re-review. Koios script_info confirms the iUSD minting policy f66d78b4a3cb3d37afa0ec36461e51ecbde00f26c8f0a68f94b69880 is a plutusV2 script (1189 bytes, creation tx 99329591f444f68ed4a33ed664c146fbf278cf9202067974cfa1a26d09a34107): no privileged owner or minter address, minting enforced by CDP collateral logic, and immutable — Cardano policy hashes permanently bind the script, so neither the DAO nor any admin can upgrade or replace the iUSD minting validator for the existing asset. The INDY DAO on-chain governance surface named in Indigo's official mainnet V3 system parameters (GOV_NFT 2fccae8b..., poll manager 2c64c712..., gov execute 0e764163..., treasury 46ffe1d1..., UPGRADE ca72f111..., VERSION_RECORD d626ddf3...) was verified on-chain via Koios: all six scripts exist (plutusV2/plutusV3). Governance authority is therefore parameter-and-version control through the upgrade-token mechanism, not mint authority over iUSD. Economic cap semantics: bounded — iUSD mints only against overcollateralized CDP collateral.
